# deceiver

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:roleDeceiver`](gmeow-roleDeceiver.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/roleDeceiver>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

The participant in a deception event who projects a standpoint that diverges from what they hold true. In self-deception, this role is borne by the same entity as [`roleDeceived`](gmeow-roleDeceived.md).
